independence_boundary: Reviewer authored G20_ASSET_REGISTRY_20261112.json. That registry is excluded from this independent approval; a different reviewer must inspect it. Review here is independent only for root roadmap and separate-author cohort/spec files.

open_findings.location: Roadmap §3.2 / Cohort §5 first two neutral pilots
open_findings.finding: 首2条可计入192个唯一Dense条件，但若每条需要plain/tap完整中性对照，还需2次额外完整执行。现有192预算只计条件，没有明示中性控制执行数。
open_findings.required_change: 分别记录192个唯一条件、192个capture执行及最多2个plain neutral执行（共194次），或冻结替代中性验收和其真实extra-forward计数；失败/重试另记。
open_findings.counterexample: 两个新UNBOUND源没有现成plain参考。每源只生成一条tap轨迹，无法得到同源同seed的独立plain终端对照；生成plain后实际执行数变成194。

nonblocking_execution_conditions.condition: DEV covers four of eight subtopics per primary stratum; confirmation covers all eight. DEV variance is a working approximation for the wider fine-semantic mixture, not an empirical certificate. Final-N freeze should include conservative sensitivity or added development evidence for missing subtopics.
N144 creates12 sources per stratum, so specify which subtopics repeat and whether source or subtopic weights define the target mixture; freeze in the expanded actual manifest before outcomes.
All240 source slots are UNBOUND. Inspect real images, current exposure and source-family duplicates before eligibility; metadata-only plan does not establish acquisition feasibility.
Full80 native target provenance and stored full-M proxy statistics must be in the producer contract before C1; saved2048 rows cannot later reconstruct author block means.
All output-count planning is conditional, not new ACTIVE authorization. Keep source count, unique condition count, complete model execution count and timing repetition count separate.

statistical_boundary: One image/source cluster is independent; seeds, prompts, frames, rows and timing repetitions are nested. Claimed population is the frozen12-primary-stratum mixture. Per-stratum n8 does not guarantee powered stratum claims.
next_review: After author responses, reread changed files and record new actual SHA; do not treat proposed fixes as approval.
